items.title: Beast Wars: Transformers PAL(native 576p) Complete Series with Bonus Features
items.description:
Uploaded are all 3 seasons of Beast Wars: Transformers in their native format sourced from the R4 DVD's released by Madman Entertainment.

Animated in Canada by Mainframe Entertainment in the mid-1990's, the series was rendered in 576p at 25fps(PAL format)
